headline: First run. One subject followed across filings, then every open item on the public register, stated once, so that the next briefing can report only what moved.
scope: Built from the public record alone: filings accepted by EDGAR and press releases, as they stood on August 31, 2026. No internal source of any kind. Company pages are excluded here: a live page carries no version history, so it cannot stand as evidence of an earlier state.

items.headline: Stockholders have thirteen days left to put a director or a proposal on the 2026 annual meeting

chain.label: WHAT HAPPENED
chain.text: The bylaws set a window for stockholder proposals and director nominations at the 2026 annual meeting. The proxy statement filed on October 28, 2025 states it: it opened on August 14, 2026 and it shuts at the close of business on September 13, 2026.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: any stockholder who would like to have a proposal considered at our 2026 annual meeting of stockholders must submit the proposal to the Secretary of the Company [...] not earlier than the close of business on August 14, 2026, and not later than the close of business on September 13, 2026

chain.label: WHAT CHANGED
chain.text: The window opened seventeen days ago. Thirteen days are left. A separate deadline, June 30, 2026, for proposals to be printed in the proxy itself, has already gone by.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: any stockholder who would like to have a proposal considered at our 2026 annual meeting of stockholders must submit the proposal to the Secretary of the Company [...] not earlier than the close of business on August 14, 2026, and not later than the close of business on September 13, 2026

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: in order for a stockholder proposal to be included in the Company's proxy statement for its 2026 annual meeting, such proposal must be received at the Company's principal executive offices

chain.label: WHY IT MATTERS
chain.text: The same paragraph reopens the window for ten days after a public announcement if the 2026 meeting falls more than 30 days before, or more than 60 days after, December 12, 2026. The public record does not state the date of that meeting.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: unless the date of our 2026 annual meeting is more than 30 days before or more than 60 days after December 12, 2026, in which case the proposal must be received no later than the 10th day following the day on which public announcement of the date of such meeting is first made

items.headline: Two public statements of the board's size, in the same filing, do not match
answers: WHAT SHOULD I KNOW THAT NOBODY HAS DIRECTLY TOLD ME

chain.label: WHAT HAPPENED
chain.text: Item 5.02 of the Form 8-K filed on July 22, 2026 says the Board increased its size from six directors to seven and appointed Matthew Kreps. The press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to that same Form 8-K says the Board increased its size from five to six.

sources.title: Form 8-K, Item 5.02: appointment of a seventh director
sources.quote: increased the size of the Board from six directors to seven directors and appointed Matthew Kreps to the Board

sources.title: Press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the July 22, 2026 Form 8-K
sources.quote: it has increased the size of its Board of Directors from five to six directors and has appointed Matt Kreps as a director of the Company

chain.label: WHAT CHANGED
chain.text: Six directors stood for election at the December 12, 2025 annual meeting: Thomas B. Pickens III, Tom Wilkinson, Bob McFarland, Eric Stober, John Halinski and Charles Winn.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: the Board has nominated Thomas B. Pickens III, Tom Wilkinson, Bob McFarland, Eric Stober, John Halinski, and Charles Winn to the Board to serve as directors until the 2026 Annual Meeting

sources.title: Form 8-K: annual meeting results and Amendment No. 3 to the Rights Agreement
sources.quote: On December 12, 2025, the Company held its annual meeting of stockholders

chain.label: WHY IT MATTERS
chain.text: Read against the proxy, the Item 5.02 figure is the one that agrees with the rest of the record. The 2026 proxy statement will state one number.

alert_rule.rule: Three or more amended insider reports accepted inside one hour.
alert_rule.caveat: An illustrative rule, written for this sample. Nothing here has been approved by anyone at Astrotech.

crosses.text: Nothing in this window crosses it. Replayed over the same sources, the rule stays silent, and a silent day is reported as a silent day.

does_not_cross.text: The press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the June 16 Form 8-K carries the same event as the filing it is attached to. One event, one alert. Republishing a document, or the same news arriving by a second route, fires nothing.

sources.title: Press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the June 16, 2026 Form 8-K
sources.quote: The Company is evaluating a potential sale to provide additional capital for the previously announced lunar mining initiative the company is committed to building.

alert_rule.production: A rule worth switching on weighs three things this one ignores: how urgent it is, whether the Chairman's own intervention is needed, and whether the matter has already reached him. A decision he took himself before it was published is not an alert.
